about_the_game:
Discover the magical world of Love Letters: First Bloom, where the challenge of word games meets the serenity of a spring garden. Create your own quiet corner where your mind can freely wander through the garden of words.

- Word game available in 8 languages

- Mysterious blocks reveal hidden letters

- Locked letters unlock when adjacent words are solved

- Engaging pattern matching puzzle

- Play with mouse or keyboard

- Relaxing background music accompanies your journey

- Infinite unique puzzles in every new game
